_about: Dashboard Plus (Build Spec v1): settings for the new tabs only. The existing dashboard's config.json is never read for anything new and never changed (except the tab list). Every input the spec asks for that has not been supplied is null here; its card shows 'Input needed: ...', never an estimate.

bq._about: New tables and views go to this dataset only (created once by the owner, Mumbai region like Maplemonk). Maplemonk is read, never written.

junk._about: Spec M3: a source with 1,000+ sessions a day and either CVR below 0.05% or engaged-session rate below 20%. Starting points; tune after two weeks of data.

click_jump._about: Highlight a campaign's click-to-session ratio when it moves more than this from its 14-day median.

ga4_channels._about: GA4 session source -> the dashboard's channel names (for the reconciliation table).

inputs_needed.event_match_quality: Meta Event Match Quality: approval to read Meta's dataset quality (a new Meta API read), or an export of it
inputs_needed.reddit_clicks: Reddit link clicks per campaign (a Reddit Ads export or API access; only Reddit spend is loaded today)

data_health._about: Spec M3 data-health score: share of inputs loaded within their refresh window, weighted by the revenue share they carry. Weights are the channel's share of last-click Total sales over the last 30 days; Shopify orders and sessions carry the whole store (weight 1).

profit._about: Spec M1. Each input is a Google Sheet id in an environment variable (like the existing spend sheets); the sheet is shared with the dashboard's service account as Viewer. Until it is set, the cards that need it show 'Input needed'.

break_even_reference.note: Spec: 1.7x is the reference line on ROAS charts until per-SKU break-even is calculated.

profit.gst_source: Owner (Nov 2026): Total sales includes GST. The GST is not one rate (products, shipping and freebies are taxed differently), so it is taken from the tax Shopify charged on the same valid orders each day: GST on Total sales = Total sales x (order tax / order total) for the days in view.
profit.cogs_format: Tab 'COGS', header row 1: sku | landed_cost | effective_from (YYYY-MM-DD). One row per variant SKU; a new row with a later effective_from changes the cost from that date. Bundles list the sum of their components.
profit.rate_card_format: Tab 'Rate card', header row 1: item | value | unit | effective_from. Items: forward_shipping (INR per shipped order), rto_shipping (INR per RTO order), reverse_shipping (INR per return), cod_fee (INR per COD order or % of COD value), gateway_fee (% of prepaid value), packaging (INR per order).
profit.influencer_format: Tab 'Actual Budget Spends': a row of month names (April ... March, the financial year starting influencer_fy_start) and a row labelled 'Actual Spend' with INR per month. Only months that have ended count (later columns may hold the plan); each month is spread evenly over its days. Awareness ad spend is already in the dashboard (Meta / Google awareness).
profit.finance_pl_note: Phase 1 gate: CM2 within 5% of the finance P&L for one month. Needs one month of the finance P&L.

site.changes_format: Tab 'Changes', header row 1: Date | Task | Assigned By | Details | ... | Status | Went Live on. A change is marked on the day it went live (Status 'Done' with a 'Went Live on' date, DD/MM/YYYY); rows still in progress are counted, not marked.
site.cooee_note: Cooee test start / stop markers: waiting on Cooee's export or API (asked separately).

stock._about: Spec M7: a daily snapshot starts now because stock history cannot be backfilled. Two snapshots a day at most one per date: Shopify available units per variant (the spec's source) and the Unicommerce warehouse snapshot already in BigQuery (overwritten upstream every day).
